::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}/deliveries"}
#docs
`limit` defaults to 100 here, the page size this list had before it paginated. Day filters use the organization's timezone.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The webhook endpoint's id. |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of rows to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor |
| `offset` | `string` | no | The previous page's next_offset — the same token as next_cursor under a second name. Pass one of offset or starting_after, not two different values. |
| `include_deleted` | `boolean` | no | Accepted; deliveries are never deleted by a caller, so it changes nothing. |
| `q` | `string` | no | Delivery id, event id (`evt_…`) or the id of the object the event is about |
| `sort_by[asc]` | `string` | no | Sort ascending by this field. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort descending by this field. |
| `id` | `object` | no | Filter on `id`. Send as `id[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `status` | `object` | no | `pending`, `delivered`, `failed`, `skipped` or `superseded`. |
| `event` | `object` | no | The event id (`evt_…`). |
| `event_type` | `object` | no | Filter on `event_type`. Send as `event_type[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `attempts` | `object` | no | Filter on `attempts`. Send as `attempts[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `created_at` | `object` | no | Filter on `created_at`. Send as `created_at[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `last_attempt_at` | `object` | no | Filter on `last_attempt_at`. Send as `last_attempt_at[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `http_status` | `object` | no | The last attempt's HTTP status. A value is an exact code (`404`), a class (`4xx`), an inclusive range (`404-412`) or `timeout`: attempted, and no HTTP response came back (timeout, refused connection, blocked address). `in` takes several, OR-ed: `4xx,timeout`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `webhook_delivery`. One of `webhook_delivery`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The delivery id. |
| `data.event` | `string` | The event id. |
| `data.event_type` | `string` | The event type. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The delivery state. One of `pending`, `delivered`, `failed`. |
| `data.attempts` | `integer` | Number of delivery attempts. |
| `data.last_attempt_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the last attempt ran. |
| `data.next_attempt_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the next attempt runs. |
| `data.last_response_status` | `integer` | The HTTP status of the last response. |
| `data.last_error` | `string` | The error of the last attempt. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the delivery was created. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True if more items follow this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque cursor; pass it as `starting_after` to read the next page. |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Count of the filtered set. First page only. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | One page of webhook_delivery |
| `400` | Unknown filter, operator or value |
| `404` | No such endpoint, or it is in the other partition |

curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/webhook_endpoints/whe_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/deliveries?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
